## Documentation check

Complete this check for any change to `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or
other project documentation. See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for the full rules.

- [ ] The three longest sentences are under the word limit for their
      type (20 words for procedural text, 25 words for descriptive
      text).
- [ ] The text has no contractions, no "should", no "however", no
      "therefore".
- [ ] Every "if" and "when" comes at the start of its sentence, before
      the instruction.
- [ ] The text uses "configuration", "check", and "run" only, not their
      synonyms.
- [ ] Each list has a colon on the lead-in line and no comma or
      semicolon at the end of an item.

Not applicable if this pull request has no documentation change.
